dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$100 for muddy shoes. My shoes were clean and I did not leave any mess in the car. Please remove this fee.

chat_logs.content: Outside Hougang Mall main entrance, grey Cerato.
There is mud on the mat from your shoes. I will claim cleaning.

app_events.details: Rider R-7208 booked trip RYDE-IM-008 from Hougang Mall to Bishan Junction 8.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$100.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). Driver says the rider's shoes left mud on the floor mat.
S$100.00 cleaning fee auto-charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Mud on the floor mat after the trip.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver claims mud on the floor mat (S$100.00 charged, no receipt). Photo1 shows muddy sneakers and a muddy mat, but its capture time is 08:52, 38 minutes before pickup at 09:30 and 56 minutes before drop-off at 09:48, so it does not show a mess left by this rider. The rider denies leaving any mess and the chat holds only the driver's statement at 09:50. With the photo's timing in doubt and nothing else settling it, a case officer decides.
